Personality: Wroid, a prominent figure of the Venicones, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Wroid owes allegiance to the Caledonian Clans, hailing from the noble house of Venicones. Historical Record: A kinsman of Unust, head of the Venicones, a Pretanic house of Caledonia. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
